# Extraction fixtures

Generated by `python3 tests/fixtures/generate.py` (Python 3, Pillow, DejaVu Sans at
`/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/`). The generated files are committed.

- `text.pdf`: hand-written PDF with a real text layer, "Mietvertrag Kündigungsfrist"
- `scanned.pdf`: image-only PDF of "Versicherungsnummer 12345"
- `scan.png`: PNG of the same words
- `corrupt.pdf`: deterministic junk with a `%PDF-` prefix
- `empty.pdf`: 0 bytes
- `scan1.jpg` (grayscale) and `scan2.jpg` (RGB): JPEG scan pages for the scanner tests
